record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Official county, court or professional office public contact evidence
sources.stated_purpose: Public defense administrative inquiries and applicable court-appointed services.
sources.limitations: Both official county pages identify the officeholder and publish the same professional address. County describes contracted indigent defense and court appointment requirements. Public defenders serve eligible clients in matters within their statutory or contracted remit; the address is not an independent medical-abuse investigation or general civil legal advice channel. Reconfirm role, mailbox, jurisdiction, eligibility and channel purpose before use. Do not send confidential information by ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
